## Checklist · قائمة التحقق

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] New user-facing text exists in English **and** Arabic (`src/i18n/strings.ts`)
- [ ] Checked the change in Arabic (RTL) as well as English
- [ ] No change to the on-disk JSON format, or it only **adds** fields
- [ ] Screenshots for UI changes (both languages if the layout changed)
